title: Ada and the Asset
author: Jude Lockridge
blurb: Yara Ashgrove, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
